# GREETING WISHES

## AIM

To create a lightful happy new year wishes using LED.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;

### WORKING

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;The illuminated paper craft works by connecting a low-voltage battery to hidden LEDs, which safely convert electricity into cool light through electroluminescence. Because paper is translucent, its internal fibers act as an optical diffuser that shatters the LED's harsh, focused beam and scatters the light rays evenly in every direction. When this scattered light bounces off the inner walls of the hollow 3D shapes, it creates a lightbox effect that eliminates shadows, while the colored paper fibers filter the light to emit a soft ,energy, calm, and enthusiasm, blue,red,orange glow.

#### COMPONENTS USED&nbsp;

Red,Blue,Orange LED

Lithium battery CR2032

Coloured paper

Aluminium foil(used as a wire)

Tape

&nbsp;

##### USES / APPLICATIONS

💡 Decorative lighting model

🎓 Simple electronics demonstration

🔋 Demonstrates battery-powered circuits

🔴 Demonstrates LED polarity and operation

🌞 Used as a Greeting card

🧑‍🏫 Useful for basic electronics exhibitions and craft projects
